 0 13px #a7fff4)}
.v030-room.v034-hit-flash .v030-glow{animation:v034-world-impulse 1.15s ease-out both!important}
@keyframes v034-world-impulse{0%{opacity:.15;filter:brightness(1)}24%{opacity:1;filter:brightness(2)}100%{opacity:.15;filter:brightness(1)}}
.v030-room.v034-hit-flash .v030-signal{box-shadow:0 0 26px #fbe09da1,0 0 52px #a7e8ffc7!important;transition:box-shadow .3s}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .v031-room .v034-physics-caption{top:69%;left:61%;max-width:57vw;font-size:9px;padding:5px 7px}
 .v031-room .v034-physics-caption span{font-size:8px;white-space:normal}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.v031-room .v034-physics-caption{top:68%;left:63%;max-width:57vw}}

<script id="v034-physical-resonance-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 /* Scientific logic is read-only: game-native period() and state.rhythmHit are authoritative.
    A short in-world contact starts a visual apparatus; a successful native push
    makes the matching-frequency receiver grow in amplitude. */
 const isStage=()=>{try{return state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s11'&&document.body.dataset.scene==='world';}catch(_){return false;}};
 const reduced=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
 let room=null,canvas=null,ctx=null,lastFrame=0,lastDraw=0,smoothed=0,lastHits=0,flashStart=-1;
 const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v));
 function attach(){
  if(!isStage()){room=null;canvas=null;ctx=null;lastFrame=0;lastHits=0;return;}
  const next=document.querySelector('#app .v031-room');
  if(!next||!next.isConnected)return;
  if(next!==room){room=next;canvas=next.querySelector('.v034-physics-canvas');ctx=canvas?.getContext('2d');lastFrame=0;smoothed=0;lastHits=0;}
 }
 function drawOrb(c,x,y,r,tint,glow,bright){
  const g=c.createRadialGradient(x-r*.38,y-r*.48,1,x,y,r*1.2);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff');g.addColorStop(.23,bright?'#ffface':'#e3f5ff');g.addColorStop(.54,tint);g.addColorStop(1, '#192944');
  c.save();c.shadowColor=glow;c.shadowBlur=bright?22:12;c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  c.shadowBlur=0;c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,240,187,.9)';c.lineWidth=1.4;c.stroke();
  // Faceted hardware, not just a moving point-light.
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,250,215,.42)';c.lineWidth=.85;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,r*.67,r*.95,-.38,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
  c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-r*.8,y);c.lineTo(x+r*.8,y);c.moveTo(x,y-r*.85);c.lineTo(x,y+r*.85);c.stroke();c.restore();
 }
 function draw(now){
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  if(!isStage()||!room||!room.isConnected||room.hidden||!canvas||!ctx)return;
  if(now-lastDraw<34)return;lastDraw=now;
  const box=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),w=box.width,h=box.height;
  if(w<40||h<40)return;
  const dpr=Math.min(1.6,window.devicePixelRatio||1),pw=Math.round(w*dpr),ph=Math.round(h*dpr);
  if(canvas.width!==pw||canvas.height!==ph){canvas.width=pw;canvas.height=ph;}
  const c=ctx;c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const started=room.dataset.v034Started==='true'||state.rhythmHit>0;
  const hits=clamp(Number(state.rhythmHit)||0,0,4),dt=lastFrame?clamp((now-lastFrame)/1000,0,.1):0;lastFrame=now;
  smoothed+=(hits-smoothed)*Math.min(1,dt*4.8);
  if(hits>lastHits){flashStart=now;}lastHits=hits;
  // Real small-angle pendulum period from the existing physics model.
  const periodSec=period(60,12),t=now/1000;
  const phase=2*Math.PI*t/periodSec;
  const mobile=w<720,r=mobile?11:17;
  const xs=mobile?[.40,.59,.78]:[.45,.57,.69],top=mobile?h*.525:h*.51,L=mobile?Math.min(h*.12,108):Math.min(h*.14,122);
  const angle1=started?.20*Math.cos(phase):0;
  // Matched oscillator builds amplitude after correctly timed impulses.
  const angle2=started?(.018+.065*smoothed)*Math.cos(phase-.22):0;
  // Shorter by (0.79)^2 in length, so its natural period is 0.79× (small-angle T∝sqrt(L)).
  const angle3=started?.035*Math.cos(phase/0.79+.33):0;
  const angles=[angle1,angle2,angle3],labels=['動かす','同じ周期','異なる周期'];
  const highlightAge=(now-flashStart)/1000,burst=highlightAge>=0&&highlightAge<1.1?Math.exp(-highlightAge*3):0;
  c.save();
  // Floating mounting rail makes each bob clearly a separate front-of-scene mechanism.
  const railY=top-12;
  const aX=w*xs[0]-r*2,bX=w*xs[2]+r*2;
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,218,139,.77)';c.lineWidth=mobile?2:3;
  c.shadowColor='rgba(254,201,102,.78)';c.shadowBlur=9;
  c.beginPath();c.moveTo(aX,railY);c.lineTo(bX,railY);c.stroke();
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const pivot=w*xs[i],theta=angles[i],lengthPx=(i===2?L*.6241:L),x=pivot+lengthPx*Math.sin(theta),y=top+lengthPx*Math.cos(theta);
    const resonance=i===1;
    const tint=i===0?'#c79b53':resonance?'#74d9ff':'#8ea7c3';
    const glow=i===0?'#ffe5aa':resonance?'#9cf4ff':'#bfceec';
    const contrast=resonance?smoothed:0;
    c.save();c.shadowColor=glow;c.shadowBlur=resonance?9+contrast*3:5;
    c.strokeStyle=resonance?'rgba(159,243,255,.92)':'rgba(253,227,160,.85)';c.lineWidth=mobile?1.8:2.4;
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(pivot,top);c.lineTo(x,y);c.stroke();
    c.fillStyle='#ffdd99';c.beginPath();c.arc(pivot,top,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.restore();
    // Motion trail tracks actual bob coordinates and becomes luminous with energy transfer.
    if(started && (resonance?smoothed>0.1:i===0)){
      c.save();c.strokeStyle=resonance?`rgba(123,231,250,${.10+.12*smoothed})`:'rgba(250,218,151,.28)';
      c.lineWidth=mobile?1.5:2;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(pivot,top+lengthPx,lengthPx*Math.sin(i===1?.018+.065*smoothed:.20),lengthPx*.10,0,0,Math.PI);c.stroke();c.restore();
    }
    drawOrb(c,x,y,r,tint,glow,resonance&&hits>0);
    if(resonance&&burst>0){c.save();c.strokeStyle=`rgba(185,251,255,${burst*.75})`;c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+8+25*(1-burst),0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.restore();}
    c.save();c.textAlign='center';c.font=`800 ${mobile?9:11}px system-ui, sans-serif`;c.fillStyle=i===1?'#c4faff':'#ffe7b5';c.shadowColor='#001526';c.shadowBlur=6;c.fillText(labels[i],pivot,top-18);c.restore();
  }
  if(started){
   c.textAlign='center';c.font=`700 ${mobile?10:12}px system-ui`;
   c.fillStyle=hits>=4?'#d7ffee':'#fff2c5';c.shadowColor='#000';c.shadowBlur=7;
   c.fillText(hits>=4?'同じ周期の振り子が大きく揺れた！':`振幅の変化を観察しよう · 成功 ${hits}/4`,w*.59,top+L+r+22);
  }
  c.restore();
 }
 document.addEventListener('furiko:resonance-contact',e=>{
  if(e.detail?.stage!=='s11')return;
  const label=e.target.querySelector?.('.v034-physics-caption span');
  if(label)label.textContent='動き始めた！ 同じ周期の振り子に注目';
 });
 document.addEventListener('furiko:resonance-hit',e=>{
  const label=document.querySelector('#app .v034-physics-caption span');
  if(label)label.textContent=e.detail?.hits>=4?'同じ周期の振り子が大きく揺れた！':'成功すると共振側の振幅が大きくなる';
 });
 setInterval(attach,370);attach();requestAnimationFrame(draw);
})();
</script>
<style id="v035-cascade-style">
/* v0.35 Science-driven restoration: scene response reads existing native hit state.
   Mechanisms are *powered* fantasy machinery triggered by the resonance sensor,
   never a scientific assertion that passive resonance creates energy. */
.v030-room,.v031-room {--v035-glow:0;}
.v035-effects{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate;color:#fff0c8;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif;}
.v035-effects *{box-sizing:border-box}
.v035-gearbox{position:absolute;left:77%;top:29%;width:clamp(80px,14vw,220px);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:.24;filter:grayscale(.6) drop-shadow(0 0 3px #b8d3e2);transition:opacity .9s,filter .9s;}
.v035-gearbox svg{position:absolute;width:60%;height:60%;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px #000b);}
.v035-cog1{left:0;top:0;transform-origin:50% 50%;}
.v035-cog2{left:45%;top:45%;width:49%!important;height:49%!important;transform-origin:50% 50%;}
.v035-gearbox .v035-gear-core{fill:#142c41;stroke:#fff1ba;stroke-width:2.5}
.v035-gearbox polygon{fill:#d2a45c;stroke:#ffe5a5;stroke-width:2.3;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.v035-gearbox path{stroke:#fff3b7;stroke-width:2;fill:none;opacity:.75}
.v035-effects[data-phase="1"] .v035-gearbox,.v035-effects[data-phase="2"] .v035-gearbox,.v035-effects[data-phase="3"] .v035-gearbox,.v035-effects[data-phase="4"] .v035-gearbox{opacity:.94;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 13px #ffe2a0) drop-shadow(0 0 27px #ffc46d8b)}
.v035-effects[data-phase]:not([data-phase="0"]) .v035-cog1{animation:v035-cog-forward 13s linear infinite}
.v035-effects[data-phase]:not([data-phase="0"]) .v035-cog2{animation:v035-cog-reverse 9s linear infinite}
@keyframes v035-cog-forward {to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes v035-cog-reverse {to{transform:rotate(-360deg)}}
.v035-glyph{position:absolute;left:57%;top:84%;width:min(69vw,450px);height:min(20vh,154px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #80f4ff);transition:opacity .8s;}
.v035-glyph svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.v035-glyph .v035-ellipse{fill:none;stroke:#75eaff;stroke-width:2;stroke-dasharray:9 9}
.v035-glyph .v035-gold{stroke:#ffe5a0;stroke-width:2;stroke-dasharray:none}
.v035-glyph .v035-glyph-center{fill:#8df0ff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #d5ffff)}
.v035-effects[data-phase="2"] .v035-glyph,.v035-effects[data-phase="3"] .v035-glyph,.v035-effects[data-phase="4"] .v035-glyph{opacity:1}
.v035-effects[data-phase="2"] .v035-glyph svg,.v035-effects[data-phase="3"] .v035-glyph svg,.v035-effects[data-phase="4"] .v035-glyph svg{animation:v035-glyph-breathe 3.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v035-glyph-breathe{from{filter:brightness(.65)}to{filter:brightness(1.5)}}
.v035-beacon{position:absolute;left:57%;top:44%;height:44%;width:clamp(24px,6vw,96px);transform:translateX(-50%);opacity:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#a3f8ff60 22%,#fff7dbaa 48%,#8defff62 76%,transparent);filter:blur(7px);transition:opacity 1s;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.v035-beacon:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4% -170%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 90%,#c5fcff89,transparent 65%);}
.v035-effects[data-phase="3"] .v035-beacon,.v035-effects[data-phase="4"] .v035-beacon{opacity:.85;animation:v035-ray-rise 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v035-ray-rise{from{filter:blur(10px) brightness(.8)}to{filter:blur(5px) brightness(1.35)}}
.v035-victory-halo{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 57% 44%,#fff0a52a,transparent 55%),linear-gradient(180deg,#c3f9ff09,#fff2ba13 65%,transparent);transition:opacity 1.5s;}
.v035-effects[data-phase="4"] .v035-victory-halo{opacity:1}
.v035-restoration{position:absolute;left:50%;top:20%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:7;max-width:calc(100vw - 30px);width:max-content;padding:9px 13px 10px;border:1px solid #f7d89999;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#061622eb,#173446dc);box-shadow:0 5px 20px #000b,0 0 18px #d5e8fb24;text-align:center;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;}
.v035-progress-title{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.055em;color:#f9dca0;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:5px}
.v035-steps{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;white-space:nowrap;}
.v035-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:#b3c7cf;transition:color .3s;}
.v035-step b{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;background:#172d3a;border:1px solid #819ba04f;}
.v035-step.active{color:#fff3cf}.v035-step.active b{background:#bd9352;border-color:#fff2be;box-shadow:0 0 13px #ffe4a9b7;color:#10202a}
.v035-step + .v035-step:before{content:'›';padding-right:4px;color:#ffe8bd8a}
.v035-description{padding-top:6px;color:#d2f2ed;font-size:10px;min-height:18px}
.v035-burst{position:absolute;left:57%;top:46%;font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,32px);color:#ffffdc;opacity:0;text-shadow:0 0 15px #fff8c4,0 0 26px #9febf8;}
.v035-effects.v035-pulse .v035-burst{animation:v035-burst .9s ease-out both}
.v035-burst:nth-of-type(1){--bx:-88px;--by:-90px}.v035-burst:nth-of-type(2){--bx:95px;--by:-65px}.v035-burst:nth-of-type(3){--bx:68px;--by:105px}.v035-burst:nth-of-type(4){--bx:-105px;--by:90px}
@keyframes v035-burst{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.3)}25%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--bx)),calc(-50% + var(--by))) scale(1.2)}}
.v035-effects.v035-pulse .v035-restoration{animation:v035-announce .9s ease-out}
@keyframes v035-announce{0%{box-shadow:0 0 10px #ffe6ad11}45%{box-shadow:0 0 32px #ffe6adbe}100%{box-shadow:0 5px 20px #000b}}
/* Prevent the restoration progress meter from obscuring the playable controls. */
.v031-room .v035-restoration{top:clamp(153px,19vh,198px);left:51%;}
.v030-room .v035-restoration{top:clamp(160px,19vh,190px);left:50%;}

.v030-room .v035-glyph{top:77%}
.v030-room .v035-beacon{top:42%;height:32%}
@media(max-width:760px){

 .v035-glyph{top:79%;width:78vw;height:14vh}
 .v035-beacon{top:52%;height:29%;width:28px}

 .v035-progress-title{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:3px}
 .v035-steps{gap:3px}
 .v035-step{gap:2px;font-size:9px}
 .v035-step b{width:15px;height:15px;font-size:8px}
 .v035-step + .v035-step:before{padding-right:2px}
 .v035-description{font-size:9px;padding-top:4px;min-height:15px}
 .v031-room .v035-restoration{top:158px;left:50%}
 .v030-room .v035-restoration{top:168px;left:48%}

}
@media(max-width:360px){

 .v035-step{font-size:8px}

}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .v035-cog1,.v035-cog2,.v035-glyph svg,.v035-beacon,.v035-burst,.v035-restoration{animation:none!important}
 .v035-effects[data-phase="4"] .v035-victory-halo{opacity:.7}
}

data-at="1"><b>1</b>歯車</span><span class="v035-step" data-at="2"><b>2</b>床</span><span class="v035-step" data-at="3"><b>3</b>光</span><span class="v035-step" data-at="4"><b>4</b>復旧</span></div>\n <div class="v035-description">振り子のタイミングを合わせよう</div>\n</div>\n</div>';
 let currentStage=false,lastHits=-1,lastRooms=[],lastPulse=0;
 const hits=()=>Math.max(0,Math.min(4,Number(state.rhythmHit)||0));
 function eligible(){try{return state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s11'&&document.body.dataset.scene==='world'}catch(_){return false}}
 function decorate(root){
  if(!root || !root.isConnected)return;
  if(!root.querySelector(':scope > .v035-effects'))root.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
  if(root.classList.contains('v030-room')){
   const reward=root.querySelector('.v030-reward');
   const actions=reward?.querySelector('div[style*="margin-top"]');
   if(actions&&!actions.querySelector('[data-v035-observe]')){
    const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';
    button.textContent='復旧した広間を見る';button.dataset.v035Observe='';
    button.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();reward.hidden=true;reward.dataset.dismissed='true';
      root.closest('.stage-viewport')?.querySelector('[data-v031-return]')?.click();});
    actions.append(button);
   }
  }
 }
 function reflect(root,n,pulse){
  const overlay=root?.querySelector(':scope > .v035-effects');if(!overlay)return;
  overlay.dataset.phase=String(n);
  overlay.querySelector('.v035-count').textContent=n+' / 4';
  overlay.querySelector('.v035-description').textContent=labels[n];
  overlay.querySelectorAll('[data-at]').forEach(node=>node.classList.toggle('active',Number(node.dataset.at)<=n));
  if(pulse){
    overlay.classList.remove('v035-pulse');void overlay.offsetWidth;overlay.classList.add('v035-pulse');
  }else if(n===0){overlay.classList.remove('v035-pulse')}
 }
 function check(){
  if(!eligible()){currentStage=false;lastHits=-1;lastRooms=[];return;}
  const roots=[document.querySelector('#app .v031-room'),document.querySelector('#app .v030-room')].filter(Boolean);
  if(!roots.length)return;
  const n=hits();
  const fresh=!currentStage || roots.some((r,i)=>r!==lastRooms[i]);
  roots.forEach(decorate);
  if(fresh || n!==lastHits){
   const animate=!fresh && lastHits>=0 && n>lastHits;
   roots.forEach(r=>reflect(r,n,animate));
   lastHits=n;lastRooms=roots;currentStage=true;
   if(animate && n>0)lastPulse=performance.now();
  }
 }
 // Hit events give an immediate reaction; polling also catches stage resets/replays.
 document.addEventListener('furiko:resonance-hit',()=>queueMicrotask(check));
 document.addEventListener('furiko:resonance-contact',()=>queueMicrotask(check));
 setInterval(check,170);check();
})();
</script>

<style id="v036-interactive-console-style">
/* In-world bridge between third-person exploration and the existing validated science experiment. */
.v031-room{--v036-lever:-22deg;--v036-hue:#76ddff;}
.v031-room .v031-target{left:64%;top:59%;animation-duration:3.8s;font-size:12px;z-index:11;}
.v036-console{position:absolute;left:64%;top:74%;z-index:6;width:clamp(80px,9vw,145px);height:clamp(93px,14vh,142px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 8px #00101bdc);pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate;}
.v036-console-foot{position:absolute;z-index:0;bottom:4%;left:-21%;width:142%;height:21%;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(-6deg);background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#061322e2 2%,#aa7d46a9 28%,#ffdf8465 39%,transparent 69%);box-shadow:0 2px 11px #060c1aba;}
.v036-control-pillar{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:17%;right:17%;top:29%;bottom:10%;clip-path:polygon(19% 0,81% 0,100% 24%,87% 100%,13% 100%,0 24%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#29200f,#b68436 15%,#ffe2a0 31%,#665124 41%,#2b2622 63%,#edb957 80%,#6d4315 100%);border:1px solid #ffde8f;box-shadow:inset 0 6px 9px #d3a74b;}
.v036-control-pillar:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:16% 8% 22%;border:1px solid #ecc88899;border-radius:4px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(155deg,transparent 0 9px,#f9ca5955 9px 10px);}
.v036-dial{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:50%;top:44%;width:clamp(18px,3.1vw,33px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#edffff 0 10%,#65e4f9 20%,#0b617c 42%,#041a36 75%);border:3px solid #f7dc92;box-shadow:0 0 11px #40cafa9c,inset 0 0 7px #c5fdff9c;}
.v036-dial i{position:absolute;inset:18%;border:1px solid #fcf1ca;border-radius:50%;}
.v036-lever{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:49%;top:-12%;width:7px;height:42%;transform:rotate(var(--v036-lever));transform-origin:50% 92%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3b2b15,#fff3c2 45%,#a97119);border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 1px 6px #000e;transition:transform .33s cubic-bezier(.15,.8,.21,1.4);}
.v036-lever span{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-5px;width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff,#a6f5ff 25%,#178fba 67%,#021c2b);border:2px solid #fff3bd;box-shadow:0 0 17px #83eaff;}
.v036-console-light{position:absolute;z-index:0;left:50%;top:28%;width:115%;height:90%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#9ad9f050 0%,#b0eaff11 41%,transparent 68%);filter:blur(12px);animation:v036-light 3.3s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
.v036-slot{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:19%;bottom:10%;height:8%;width:62%;border-radius:8px;background:#14202a;border:1px solid #ffdc8a;box-shadow:0 0 7px #8df5ff;}
.v036-activate{position:absolute;z-index:6;inset:8% 0 10%;border:0!important;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;pointer-events:auto;}
.v036-activate:focus-visible{opacity:1;background:#091b30cc!important;color:#fff!important;outline:2px solid #9ceaff!important;border-radius:10px;}
.v031-room.v036-contacting{--v036-lever:23deg;}
.v031-room.v036-contacting .v036-dial,.v031-room.v036-started .v036-dial{box-shadow:0 0 16px #84e9ff,inset 0 0 10px #fff;}
.v031-room.v036-started .v036-control-pillar{filter:brightness(1.22);}
.v031-room.v036-cleared .v036-console{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 15px #8cedff) drop-shadow(0 7px 8px #00101b);}
@keyframes v036-light{from{opacity:.38}to{opacity:.85}}
.v036-touch-link{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;overflow:visible;}
.v031-room.v036-contacting .v036-touch-link{opacity:1;}
.v036-touch-link path{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.v036-touch-link-back{stroke:#f5bd55;stroke-width:8;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #ffe48b);opacity:.35;}
.v036-touch-link-front{stroke:#d2faff;stroke-width:2.5;stroke-dasharray:6 10;animation:v036-energy .4s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #e1ffff)}
@keyframes v036-energy{to{stroke-dashoffset:-16}}
.v036-floor-reflection{position:absolute;inset:66% 0 0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.24;background:repeating-linear-gradient(103deg,transparent 0 17%,#d5bb7a5c 18%,transparent 18.5%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#93d9ec24);clip-path:polygon(43% 0,70% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);transform:translateX(var(--v31-floor,0px));mask-image:linear-gradient(transparent 0%,black 47%);}
.v036-foot-trail{position:absolute;left:var(--v31-x,30%);top:var(--v31-y,75%);z-index:2;pointer-events:none;width:66px;height:17px;transform:translate(-50%,-10%) scale(var(--v31-scale,1));border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ffdf9863;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#fff1ba69 0%,#f9c65b22 36%,transparent 72%);filter:blur(4px);opacity:.25;}
.v031-room.v032-walking .v036-foot-trail{opacity:.6;animation:v036-foot .35s linear infinite alternate;}
@keyframes v036-foot{to{filter:blur(2px);opacity:.3;transform:translate(-50%,-10%) scale(calc(var(--v31-scale,1) * .8));}}
@media(min-width:761px){.v036-console{left:62%;top:73%;}.v031-room .v031-target{left:62%;top:55%;}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .v036-console{left:65%;top:76%;width:80px;height:104px;}
 .v031-room .v031-target{left:64%;top:59%;font-size:10px;padding:7px 10px;max-width:56%;}
 .v036-dial{width:19px;border-width:2px}.v036-lever{width:5px}.v036-lever span{width:14px;height:14px}
 .v036-floor-reflection{opacity:.14}.v036-foot-trail{width:48px;height:11px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.v036-console{left:65%;top:73%;width:70px;height:86px}.v031-room .v031-target{top:57%;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v036-console-light,.v036-touch-link-front,.v036-foot-trail{animation:none!important}.v036-lever,.v036-touch-link{transition:none!important}}
</style>
<script id="v036-contact-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 // Presentation is reactive; do not modify state.rhythmHit, stage progress, or original timing rules.
 const active=()=>{try{return state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s11'&&document.body.dataset.scene==='world';}catch(_){return false}};
 let lastRoom=null,contactAt=0,until=0,started=false;
 function line(room){
  const svg=room.querySelector('.v036-touch-link'),player=room.querySelector('.v031-player'),lever=room.querySelector('.v036-lever');
  if(!svg||!player||!lever)return;
  const rr=room.getBoundingClientRect(),pr=player.getBoundingClientRect(),lr=lever.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(!rr.width||!rr.height)return;
  const ax=pr.left+pr.width*.76-rr.left,ay=pr.top+pr.height*.58-rr.top;
  const bx=lr.left+lr.width*.50-rr.left,by=lr.top+lr.height*.04-rr.top;
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${rr.width} ${rr.height}`);
  const path=`M ${ax.toFixed(1)} ${ay.toFixed(1)} Q ${((ax+bx)/2).toFixed(1)} ${(Math.min(ay,by)-24).toFixed(1)} ${bx.toFixed(1)} ${by.toFixed(1)}`;
  svg.querySelectorAll('path').forEach(p=>p.setAttribute('d',path));
 }
 function animate(now){requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  if(!active()){if(lastRoom){lastRoom.classList.remove('v036-contacting');lastRoom=null;}return;}
  const room=document.querySelector('#app .v031-room');if(!room||room.hidden)return;
  if(room!==lastRoom){lastRoom=room;started=room.dataset.v034Started==='true';room.classList.toggle('v036-started',started);}
  const contact=room.classList.contains('v033-interacting') || (now < until);
  room.classList.toggle('v036-contacting',contact);
  if(contact)line(room);
  room.classList.toggle('v036-cleared',Number(state.rhythmHit||0)>=4);
  if(room.dataset.v034Started==='true'&&!room.classList.contains('v036-started'))room.classList.add('v036-started');
 }
 document.addEventListener('furiko:resonance-contact',e=>{
  if(e.detail?.stage!=='s11')return;
  const room=e.target.closest?.('.v031-room');if(!room)return;
  room.classList.add('v036-started','v036-contacting');contactAt=performance.now();until=contactAt+930;
 });
 // Touching the in-world console delegates to existing target action via data-v031="target".
 requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>

</style></body></html>
